name: Bell AH-1 Cobra (single-engine)
summary: The classic single-engine Cobra attack helicopter, now flown by a few warbird owners.

wings: Two-blade rotor with a stabilizer bar above the head
engines: Exhaust at the rear, often with an infrared suppressor on the AH-1F
fuselage: Very narrow tandem cockpit with the gunner in front and the pilot higher behind
Chin turret or nose sight (trainers lack the turret)
tail: Tail rotor with a vertical fin and horizontal stabilizer

confusedWith.howToTell: The AH-1Z has four blades and twin engines; the single-engine Cobra has two blades and one engine.
The Apache is larger, with twin engines and a four-blade rotor; the Cobra is slimmer with two blades.
The Huey has a wide cabin and no stub wings; the Cobra is a narrow tandem attack ship.

usCount.source: FAA Releasable Aircraft Database — valid registrations
